message: In the twin-rack cold room layout (C4), Sam, the crate stacking and aisle clearance has risk of blocking airflow and overfilling the 10 cubic metre room. To check it I used volume calculation (the crate net volume calculation (E5)). I found 2.7 cubic metres net crate volume for fifty 600 by 400 by 226 millimetre crates holding 1 tonne, according to Solent Plastics datasheet, 2024 and National Centre for Cold-chain Development guideline, 2023. I propose 2.6 by 2.0 by 2.1 metre internal room with twin side racks and central aisle. My position: not ready because door and seal detail is still open. In the 100 millimetre Polyurethane insulated enclosure (PU, closed-cell foam panels) (C1), Maya, the wall heat gain and roof solar load has risk of raising daytime cooling demand. To check it I used conduction estimate (the 216 W wall gain estimate (E3)). I found 216 watts steady gain needing 100 millimetre panels at 0.23 watts per square metre kelvin, according to ISMAP cold room panel data, 2024. I propose cam-lock Polyurethane (PU) panels plus vented Photovoltaic shade roof (PV, sunlight-to-electricity panels) with 150 millimetre gap as shown in the enclosure plan and section sketch (E6). My position: not ready because transportable panel joints need proof.
